sources.scope: 31 valid distinct public cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded manifest paging, forced three-row pages, all 31 fresh source-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 54 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32735 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Source-native SDE.Lots.OBJECTID is the unique GIS reference identity; the original UPID label is retained unchanged. The first UPID identity qualification is preserved as failed: one blank UPID matched 38,736 records and cannot serve as a unique native parcel key. A fresh run using source OIDs preserves all sampled geometry and passes every query check. Provider offset pagination is unsupported; complete count-checked object-ID manifests and bounded object-ID batches are used instead. Native source CRS is EPSG:32735. The exact WUP point returned no lot; all three original nearby UPID-labelled samples match fresh full source geometry exactly. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term GIS key continuity remain unverified. Additional enabled city entries have separate bounded qualification evidence; wider coverage remains unverified.
